## Getting Started {#getting-started}

Each course below comes as a kit: a course page, a syllabus or guide, lecture
slides, and hands-on work. Everything is free and open under
[CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/).

```{=html}
<ol class="hub-steps">
  <li><strong>Pick a course</strong>Choose the course that fits your program and your students' background.</li>
  <li><strong>Open its kit</strong>Read the syllabus, then gather the slides, labs, and hardware it uses.</li>
  <li><strong>Adapt it</strong>Use the guides below to adjust pacing, assessment, and TA support for your setting.</li>
</ol>
<p class="hub-note">The <a href="getting-started.html">setup guide</a> walks through access, infrastructure, and the first week step by step.</p>
```

## Courses {#courses}

```{=html}
<div class="kit-grid">

  <article class="kit">
    <span class="kit-tag">Volume I &middot; Semester plan</span>
    <h3><a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/intro/">Introduction to Machine Learning Systems</a></h3>
    <p>Data pipelines, training, optimization, and deployment on a single machine. Students build their own framework with TinyTorch.</p>
    <p class="kit-needs"><span>You need</span>A laptop. Labs run in the browser; no GPUs needed.</p>
    <nav class="kit-links" aria-label="Introduction course kit">
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/intro/">Course</a>
      <a href="foundations-syllabus.html">Syllabus</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/slides/vol1.html">Slides</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/labs/">Labs</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/tinytorch/">TinyTorch</a>
    </nav>
  </article>

  <article class="kit">
    <span class="kit-tag">Volume II &middot; Semester plan</span>
    <h3><a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/scaling/">Scaling Machine Learning Systems</a></h3>
    <p>Distributed training, communication, fault recovery, and serving across many machines, with systems labs and a capstone.</p>
    <p class="kit-needs"><span>You need</span>A laptop. Labs simulate the cluster; no GPUs needed.</p>
    <nav class="kit-links" aria-label="Scaling course kit">
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/scaling/">Course</a>
      <a href="scale-syllabus.html">Syllabus</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/slides/vol2.html">Slides</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/labs/">Labs</a>
    </nav>
  </article>

  <article class="kit">
    <span class="kit-tag">Volume I &middot; Historical materials</span>
    <h3><a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/tinyml/">TinyML</a></h3>
    <p>Training and deploying models on microcontrollers, with earlier Harvard offerings, assignments, and example projects to adapt.</p>
    <p class="kit-needs"><span>You need</span>A microcontroller board, such as the Arduino Nicla Vision.</p>
    <nav class="kit-links" aria-label="TinyML course kit">
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/tinyml/">Course</a>
      <a href="tinyml-syllabus.html">Syllabus</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/slides/tinyml.html">Slides</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/kits/">Hardware kits</a>
    </nav>
  </article>

  <article class="kit">
    <span class="kit-tag">Volume I &middot; Learning path</span>
    <h3><a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/edge-ai/">Edge AI</a></h3>
    <p>Deployment on Linux edge devices, following Volume I with the Raspberry Pi kit and companion books.</p>
    <p class="kit-needs"><span>You need</span>A Raspberry Pi kit.</p>
    <nav class="kit-links" aria-label="Edge AI kit">
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/edge-ai/">Learning path</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/slides/vol1.html">Slides</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/kits/">Hardware kits</a>
    </nav>
  </article>

  <article class="kit kit-draft">
    <span class="kit-tag">Volume IV &middot; Draft course plan</span>
    <h3><a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/physical-ai/">Physical AI</a></h3>
    <p>A proposed hardware studio on robot policies and physical limits. Read the instructor guide before planning an offering.</p>
    <p class="kit-needs"><span>You need</span>A robot station per team; the guide lists the parts.</p>
    <nav class="kit-links" aria-label="Physical AI kit">
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/physical-ai/">Course</a>
      <a href="vol4/index.html">Instructor guide</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/slides/vol4.html">Slides</a>
      <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/labs/">Studio labs</a>
    </nav>
  </article>

</div>
<p class="hub-note">The introductory and scaling courses can also run back to back as a two-semester sequence; the <a href="course-map.html">course map</a> shows how they connect. More offerings, including courses at other schools, are in the <a href="https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/">course catalog</a>.</p>
```
